operational-example.copy: Use Breadcrumbs as a bounded component: Show the current location path inside one hierarchy without owning route architecture, side navigation, or page history.

scenario.title: Fleet vehicle trail
rationale: The ZIP reference shows a small path trail with chevron separators, text links, and a current page label.
Flow keeps route ownership outside Breadcrumbs; this component only renders a bounded location path.
The current page is not an actionable selected control, so it uses text emphasis instead of action-primary.

rows.label: Current page
rows.value: Uses Flow text emphasis, not action-primary.

rows.label: Ancestor links
rows.value: Use muted text and action-primary only on hover/focus.

rows.label: Boundary
rows.value: Navigation architecture, route guards, and IA stay in patterns.

items.rule: Owns the visible Breadcrumbs container and spacing.
Provides visible meaning and accessible name.
Shows the current page with text emphasis and aria-current. Action-primary is reserved for actionable ancestor hover/focus, not the current location label.
Keeps context short and local to the component.

accessibility.statePrecedence: disabled, current, collapsed, focus, hover, default
items: Expose current state through text or ARIA where applicable.
Keep keyboard focus visible and predictable.
Respect reduced motion for motion-bearing variants.
Escalate to a pattern when behavior exceeds one local component.

variants.copy: Breadcrumbs variants define local presentation only. Navigation architecture, route guards, and IA decisions belong to navigation patterns.

states.copy: Breadcrumbs states follow explicit precedence so location, hover, focus, collapsed, and disabled status remain readable. The current page uses Flow text emphasis because it is not an actionable selected control.

variant-state-behavior.copy: Variant controls presentation; state controls local behavior. Navigation architecture, route guards, and IA decisions belong to navigation patterns.

full-width.copy: Breadcrumbs may fill its parent when content remains readable and behavior stays local.

responsive-layout-patterns.copy: Use responsive density to preserve labels, state, and targets; do not add pattern orchestration to Breadcrumbs.

viewport-organization.copy: Viewport rules decide density and placement while Breadcrumbs remains a component.

items.title: Phone
items.rule: Use readable labels and touch-safe targets.

items.title: Tablet
items.rule: Keep the component near related context.

items.title: Desktop
items.rule: Use compact density only when state remains visible.

playground.copy: Use the playground to verify Breadcrumbs label, variant, state, full-width behavior, and pattern boundary.
playground.snippet: <Breadcrumbs items={[{ label: "Fleet", href: "#" }, { label: "JMX-214-B", current: true }]} />

api-foundations.copy: Breadcrumbs API exposes local props while Design System owns foundations, primitives, state precedence, and escalation rules.

props.name: maxItems
props.notes: Maximum visible items before overflow collapse.

props.name: state
props.type: default | hover | focus | collapsed | current | disabled

props.name: fullWidth
props.notes: Allows the trail to fill its parent width.

groups.title: Use
items: Use Breadcrumbs for one bounded component job.
Keep label, state, and context visible.
Use Design System tokens and accessibility rules.

groups.title: Avoid
items: Navigation architecture, route guards, and IA decisions belong to navigation patterns.
Do not hide required meaning in icons, color, or animation only.
Do not add process orchestration inside the component.

groups.title: Review
items: Confirm current page uses aria-current and text emphasis, not action-primary selected styling.
Check state precedence and pattern escalation.

mustTest: aria-current page uses text emphasis, not action-primary selected styling
rejectIf: Navigation architecture, route guards, and IA decisions belong to navigation patterns.
Current page is styled as an actionable selected control.
Required label or fallback is missing.

miel.copy: MIEL treats Breadcrumbs as a bounded component. Agents may place it when the job is local; humans confirm state, accessibility, content, and whether escalation to a pattern is required.
canDecide: Use Breadcrumbs for one local UI job.
Select variant and state from the Breadcrumbs contract.
Keep labels, focus, and state visible.
mustAsk: The request needs orchestration, multi-step behavior, or cross-surface state.
Navigation architecture, route guards, and IA decisions belong to navigation patterns.
Accessibility, risk, or reduced-motion expectations are unclear.
rejectIf: Navigation architecture, route guards, and IA decisions belong to navigation patterns.
Required meaning is icon-only, color-only, or motion-only.
The component becomes a process container.
miel.handoff: I am using Breadcrumbs as a bounded component. Please confirm label, state, accessibility behavior, responsive treatment, and whether this should escalate to a pattern.
